sentences.en: Chew your food well so it can be digested properly.
sentences.zh: 好好咀嚼食物以便消化。

sentences.en: He can't chew well, because he has a toothache now.
sentences.zh: 他嚼不烂，因为现在牙疼。

sentences.en: "Did you see my cat?" "No." "Liar, you're still chewing!"
sentences.zh: "你看见我的猫了吗？" "没有。" "说谎，你还嚼着呢！

senses.zh: 咀嚼；（因烦恼或焦虑）咬住；细想，深思；反刍；（非正式）闲聊
咀嚼；咀嚼物，口香糖，供咀嚼的烟草
